top_examples.hook: My husband introduced his twelve-year-old daughter at our anniversary dinner. We'd been married nine years, and he'd known about her for three.
top_examples.premise: A husband introduces a twelve-year-old daughter at his ninth-anniversary dinner after secretly knowing about and supporting the child for three years.
top_examples.title: The Girl at Our Anniversary Dinner

top_examples.hook: The daycare put my dog in an adoption parade before pickup. A volunteer called him abandoned while strangers lined up to take him home.
top_examples.premise: A pet daycare puts a paying client's dog in an adoption parade and tells the crowd he was abandoned while the owner is coming to collect him.
top_examples.title: The Adopt Me Sash at Pickup

top_examples.hook: At my sister's engagement dinner, Mom introduced our foster brother as the caterer. He had cooked every dish, but the place card she hid under his apron said "son."
top_examples.premise: At an engagement dinner, a mother tells the wealthy future in-laws that her foster son is the caterer, even though he was invited as the bride's brother and cooked the meal as a gift.
top_examples.title: Mom Called My Brother the Caterer

top_examples.hook: The groomer refused to return my dog because another customer preferred him. She offered me that customer's terrified puppy instead.
top_examples.premise: A dog groomer refuses to return a customer's dog because another family paid extra to leave with the calmer animal.
top_examples.title: The Groomer Gave My Dog to Another Family

top_examples.hook: My groom announced our wedding gifts had funded his startup. I learned about the company when he asked our guests to invest after the first dance.
top_examples.premise: A groom redirects the couple's cash wedding registry into his secret startup and asks reception guests to invest after the first dance.
top_examples.title: The Startup Pitch After Our First Dance

weak_retention_examples.hook: My groom stopped our vows to accuse me of hiding a prenup. His signature was already on a copy I'd never seen.

weak_retention_examples.title: The Prenup Arrived During Our Vows

weak_retention_examples.hook: My company accused me of threatening a customer on a shift I never worked. The security video showed my boss's son wearing a duplicate badge with my name.
weak_retention_examples.premise: An employee is disciplined for misconduct committed by her manager's son, who has been working weekend shifts under her identity with a duplicate company badge.

weak_retention_examples.premise: A groom mocks the bride's deaf father during his wedding toast after sending the hired interpreter outside, leaving the father applauding a joke made at his expense.
weak_retention_examples.title: Dad Applauded the Joke He Couldn't Hear
